detail.longDescription: Auto-instrumentation libraries capture telemetry data at the framework level. I wrote an AI agent that instruments the business logic that's unique to your code, something only achieved with manual instrumentation before. At LLMday Austin, I demoed Spinybacked Orbweaver, an AI agent that instruments code with OpenTelemetry automatically. It ensures high-quality instrumentation by using deterministic quality checks and validating its work against your OTel Weaver schema. Watch the recording here: https:// youtu.be/z6PcBzqEUf0 # LLMday # OpenTelemetry # AIAgents # Observability # Instrumentation
